notes: The ye of the second colon stands before stars rather than after Praise, so it is the vocative's under rule 36 and not the imperative's under rule 17; the first colon's ye stands beside its verb and is that verb's.
The phrase's single of stands between stars and light, so it is the rectum `אוֹר`'s under rule 19 and the quantifying construct `כֹּל` keeps only its own all.
